title: Set the creation date of a file
summary: Change the 'created' timestamp of one or more files to a specific date and time. This is useful for organizing files by when they were originally made, rather than when they were copied.

steps.explain: Use the setfile command with the -d flag to set the creation date. Replace <DATE_TIME> with the desired date in MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS format and <FILE_PATH> with the path to the file.

placeholders.name: DATE_TIME
placeholders.description: The new creation date and time in MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS format

placeholders.name: FILE_PATH
placeholders.description: Path to the file(s) to modify
